name: claude-linkedin-connector
description: Unofficial connector that lets Claude read your LinkedIn profile and publish, manage and engage with LinkedIn posts.
long_description:
Publish text, link, image and document (carousel) posts to LinkedIn from Claude, edit or delete them, and read your basic profile. With LinkedIn Community Management API access it can also comment, react and post as LinkedIn Pages you administer: turn those on in the settings.

You need your own LinkedIn developer app (free) with the "Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect" and "Share on LinkedIn" products, and http://localhost:8723/callback added as an authorized redirect URL. Ask Claude to sign you in to LinkedIn after installing.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by LinkedIn.

tools.name: linkedin_read_connections
tools.description: Search your connections in LinkedIn's data export.

tools.name: linkedin_preview_post
tools.description: Check a post and its link preview card before publishing.

tools.name: linkedin_create_post
tools.description: Publish a post with optional link preview, images or document.

tools.name: linkedin_edit_post
tools.description: Change the text of one of your posts.

tools.name: linkedin_list_posts
tools.description: List the posts you published from Claude, to edit or delete them later.

tools.name: linkedin_comment_on_post
tools.description: Comment on a post (needs Community Management API access).

tools.name: linkedin_react_to_post
tools.description: React to a post (needs Community Management API access).

tools.name: linkedin_login
tools.description: Sign in to LinkedIn in your browser.

client_id.title: LinkedIn Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of your LinkedIn developer app (Auth tab at linkedin.com/developers/apps).

client_secret.title: LinkedIn Client Secret
client_secret.description: Primary Client Secret of your LinkedIn developer app.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect URL
redirect_uri.description: Local sign-in callback. Must exactly match an authorized redirect URL in your LinkedIn app.

comments.title: Comments and reactions
comments.description: Let Claude comment on and react to posts. Needs LinkedIn's Community Management API product on your app (without it, signing in fails); sign in again after turning it on.

pages.title: Post as LinkedIn Pages
pages.description: Let Claude post, comment and react as LinkedIn Pages you administer. Needs LinkedIn's Community Management API product on your app (without it, signing in fails); sign in again after turning it on.

file_dirs.title: Folders for local files
file_dirs.description: Comma-separated folders Claude may read images, documents and Connections.csv from, instead of Downloads, Desktop and Pictures: list those too to keep them. Leave empty for the defaults.
